table_assessment.assessment_notes: Four-row provocative-test table mixing descriptive indications/positive criteria/risks with medication dosing, recording, contraindication, stopping, rescue-treatment, observation and location instructions. All 28 non-reference clinical cells are represented as exact DOM-visible cell strings; medication/procedure modality remains mixed and requires human adjudication.
